evidence: Swap test fails: the frame (pale green-grey ground, white bordered cards, one dark-green filled button, one sans family, a 2-col card grid of thumbnail + title + meta + badge) would carry a seed library, a toy library or a meeting-room booker unchanged; only the copy (deposits, 'Open' sessions, '14 Mill Lane', volunteer desk) is bound to this product. With the name hidden the thumbnails do not say these are tools: every one is the same wrench glyph on a mint square (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png).

Category-guess test fails: predicted default for a community lending/booking service = light neutral ground, one green 'community' accent, white cards with icon thumbnails, availability pills, a month calendar of open days. Every identity-carrying element matches the default.

Similar-prompt test fails: 'online reservation for a volunteer-run community seed library or kit library' would predictably land on the same card grid, green accent, icon placeholder thumbnails, availability badges and calendar.

No signature from the product's world: the membership-card green appears only as button/badge accent; nothing from the library's physical world (tool tags, the session sheet, the card itself) is drawn into the page. The calendar's 'Open' tags are the nearest mechanism-led element and are a standard calendar annotation.
